description: S458: a string-literal operand in a refinement predicate is compared as that literal. confirm(answer: string(eq("yes"))) is called with "yes" (passes; @shown becomes "yes") and then "no" (fails: the entry check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and @shown keeps "yes"). A string operand used to be emitted as bare text — a ReferenceError at the check.
rationale: §53.2.1 `value-literal = numeric-literal | string-literal`; §55.1 `eq(expr)`; §53.6.1 shared-core vocabulary in refinement-type position.
